description: A translucent yellow-green ooze, a slow-shifting amorphous blob pocked with bubbling acidic blisters and faint corrosive vapor rising off its surface. No visible face or limbs.
A thin stooped herbalist in a long dark green robe with a hood pushed back, spectacles, grey hair, and a bandolier of small corked vials across the chest.
A stocky armorer in a mail shirt under a studded leather apron, heavy bracers, short grey beard, holding a dented breastplate.
A lean human bandit in dark leather armor and a hooded cloak, a recurve bow slung across the back and a quiver of arrows at the hip, sharp watchful eyes.
A stout middle-aged man in a leather apron, rolled sleeves, ruddy cheeks, and a friendly but tired expression. Holding a rag.
A large, hulking brown bear with thick fur, rounded ears, heavy claws, and a broad snout. Muscular and imposing.
A pale eight-legged spider the size of a cat, with long hairy legs, two large fangs, and multiple glossy black eyes.
A small child in simple peasant clothes, wide curious eyes, short stature, and tousled hair. Looks slightly worried.
A tan deer standing in side profile, full body, a clear deer silhouette: arched neck, small head with large ears, four slim legs, and a short white tail. Gentle and alert.
A small hovering wisp of living flame, a flickering ember-orange core wreathed in drifting smoke and sparks, no limbs, casting a warm orange glow.
A burly weapons master in worn plate and a leather harness, a greatsword strapped to his back, scarred arms crossed, stern and confident.
A tidy shopkeeper in a brown vest over a striped shirt, a coin pouch at the belt, hands clasped, with a friendly attentive expression.
An oversized mangy rat the size of a dog, with matted grey-brown fur, yellowed buckteeth, beady red eyes, and a long scaly tail.
A small wiry green-skinned goblin, hunched posture, oversized pointed ears, yellow eyes, ragged robes, clutching a crude wooden rattle or totem in one clawed hand.
A green-skinned goblin shaman in tattered ritual robes strung with bones and feathers, hunched over a gnarled staff topped with a glowing charm, tribal paint markings on its face.
A heavily armored human guard captain in polished plate mail, a tower shield strapped to one arm, a plumed helm, broad-shouldered and imposing, standing at rigid attention.
A rough human bandit in patchwork leather armor and a stained cloak, a notched shortsword at the hip, unkempt beard, scarred face, menacing sneer.
A gaunt undead warden in corroded ceremonial armor, hollow glowing eye sockets, tattered burial cloth draped over rusted plate, radiating a faint unholy light.
A stocky soldier in padded leather armor with a short sword at his hip, a round helmet, and a watchful stern expression.
A frail elderly man with a long white beard, deep-set wise eyes, a wooden staff, and simple robes. Calm and authoritative.
A straw-stuffed training dummy on a wooden post, burlap head, painted target rings on its chest, slumped and battered from use.
A round cheerful shopkeeper in a linen shirt and a canvas apron, sleeves rolled, a strap of pouches across the chest, holding a wrapped bundle of goods.
A small brown rabbit with long upright ears, a round fluffy body, short front legs, and a white cotton tail.
A lean hooded figure in dark leathers, a dagger at each hip, half-shadowed face with a sly knowing smirk. Light on her feet.
A large frost-blue spider with long frost-rimed legs, glassy icy eyes, and a faint chill mist clinging to its segmented body — bigger and icier than the common cave spider.
A small reddish-brown squirrel with a large bushy tail curled over its back, bright eyes, and tiny paws clutching a nut.
A murky brown-green ooze dripping with swamp muck, its gelatinous body studded with drifting spore pods and embedded bog debris.
A rosy-cheeked man in a loose tunic, holding a tankard, slightly slouched on a stool. Cheerful and a bit disheveled.
A wooden wall torch with a wrapped pitch-soaked head burning a bright orange flame, casting warm light. A simple fixture.
A lean outdoorsman in a fur-trimmed cloak and worn leather vest, weathered face, with a coil of rope over one shoulder.
A wooden notice board on a single post. A village fixture.
A plain peasant in rough linen clothes and a simple tunic, weathered face, carrying a basket. Unremarkable but sturdy.
A robed human warden in reinforced leather and chainmail, a ceremonial banner-topped staff in hand, calm authoritative bearing, a protector's stance.
A broad-shouldered smith in a heavy scorched leather apron over bare arms, thick gloves, close-cropped beard, holding a hammer at the side.
An aged hedge magus in patched blue robes, a pointed hat, a gnarled staff topped with a faint glowing crystal, and a long grey beard.
A large dire wolf with shaggy grey-black fur, glowing pale eyes, bared fangs mid-howl, a muscular build and a bristled mane.
